en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Lots of people sleep in late▼when they have a day off.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;That's such a waste, don't you▼think? On my holidays, I like to▼get up EARLIER.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I think you should do what I do.▼Get up early and make the most▼of your day!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Cậu cũng nên thử đi.▼Dậy sớm để tận dụng▼từng phút trong ngày!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;A holiday is the very best time▼to study.

en: While everyone else is having▼fun, you can do extra reading▼and get ahead of your rivals!

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;At least, that's my theory. But▼every day off, all I want to do▼is go out and enjoy myself.
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;Lý thuyết là thế. Còn cứ nghỉ▼là tớ chỉ muốn ra ngoài chơi.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;I wish I knew what everyone does▼on their holidays.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I mean, I went over to visit my▼friends, but they were all out.
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Tớ sang thăm bạn bè,▼mà ai cũng đi vắng hết.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;We should have timetables for▼our days off, too. Then we'd▼know where to go, wouldn't we?
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ngày nghỉ cũng nên có thời khóa▼biểu. Thế là biết phải▼đến đâu tìm nhau rồi!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;On my days off, I like to go to▼places I've never been before.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ngày nghỉ, tớ thích đến▼những nơi chưa từng đặt chân.

en: That way, I have the chance to▼see and experience new things.▼It's very educational, you know.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You should try exploring on your▼days off, too, instead of▼sleeping the whole day away.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Cậu cũng thử khám phá đi,▼đừng ngủ hết cả ngày nghỉ!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;On my last day off, I spent the▼WHOLE day cleaning my room.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ngày nghỉ vừa rồi, tớ dọn phòng▼từ sáng đến tối luôn.

en: Once I start cleaning, I just▼can't stop. I get so into it,▼you know?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It tires me out, but it's SO▼wonderful to live in a clean,▼tidy room.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Mệt thì mệt, nhưng ở trong▼phòng sạch sẽ, ngăn nắp▼sướng không tả nổi!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;You know how everyone always▼says that they wish every day▼could be a holiday?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Well, not me. I like school.▼Learning things is fun.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Tớ thì không! Tớ thích đến lớp.▼Học điều mới vui lắm chứ!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Besides, it would get boring▼having holidays ALL the time.▼Don't you think?
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Với lại nghỉ suốt ngày▼thì chán chết. Cậu thấy sao?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;One of the best things about the▼holidays is having a nice,▼civilized cup of tea.

en: Sipping tea, nibbling on sweet▼cookies, enjoying some quiet▼thinking time...
vi: Nhấp trà, nhâm nhi bánh quy,▼ngồi tĩnh tâm suy ngẫm...

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I don't think holidays should be▼all fun and games.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Tớ nghĩ ngày nghỉ đâu chỉ▼để vui chơi suốt thôi.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;A day off is a chance to rest▼the mind and body for the▼challenges of school.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Đó là lúc cho đầu óc, cơ thể▼nghỉ ngơi, chuẩn bị▼đối mặt bài vở ở trường.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You be careful not to run around▼and tire yourself out too much.▼Recuperation is the key!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Đừng chạy nhảy mệt quá nhé.▼Phục hồi sức lực mới quan trọng!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I was just playing with a metal▼puzzle a friend lent me.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Tớ vừa thử giải món đồ▼ghép kim loại bạn cho mượn.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;She said it was easy to solve,▼but I couldn't do it.

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;I think that means it must be▼broken. If I can't do it, who▼can?

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I'm the type that always works▼hard, but even I get tired▼sometimes.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;So when we get a day off I just▼like to lie around ALL day.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Then I'm all refreshed and ready▼to go the next day.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Hôm sau lại tràn đầy năng lượng,▼sẵn sàng làm mọi thứ!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;The other day, I told off a▼little kid who was goofing off.
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Hôm nọ tớ mắng một đứa nhóc▼vì nó cứ nghịch phá.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;Everyone stared at me like I was▼bullying the kid or something.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;You know, I once forgot to do my▼homework. Can you believe that?

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;But no one was more angry about▼it than me.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I made myself stand in the▼hallway for the whole of recess▼as punishment!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I was chasing after a naughty▼kid who had been acting up...

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Don't you think that's TERRIBLY▼unfair?
$024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I saw an old lady standing near▼a crosswalk.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Tớ thấy một bà cụ▼đứng gần vạch sang đường.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;So I offered my hand and helped▼her across the street.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;You know, once I forgot to bring▼my purse when I went out▼shopping.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Can you imagine? Me? Forgetting▼something so important?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I knitted a pair of gloves for▼my father.
I really wanted to make a super▼pair of gloves, but it took so▼long!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;One time when I was playing▼dodgeball, someone threw the▼ball at me.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;When I first had them, I was so▼surprised. They didn't taste▼like cakes one bit!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I caught a cold but went to▼school anyway.

$024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;I caught someone writing▼graffiti on the school walls, so▼I yelled, "Hey, you!"

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I went looking for four-leaf▼clovers with my friend.
It didn't take me long to find▼one.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Funny thing is, she wasn't very▼grateful. She seemed kind of▼annoyed, in fact.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I've got a friend who loves▼reading, and she always lends me▼her books.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;But I'm not exactly the fastest▼reader, you know?
$024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I spend all my time just reading▼her books. It's a real chore...

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I took notes for my friend who▼had to miss class because of a▼cold.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I had two cakes, so I gave one▼to my friend.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Sometimes it's very hard being▼so nice.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;When you have a big group, it's▼SO hard to decide on a game to▼play.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Some people have short tempers,▼some people are scaredy cats...▼There are all kinds.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;I always take care to talk to▼people differently, depending on▼their personality.

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;It's not that I'm a bossy type.▼Not at all!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Right now, the most important▼thing for us is our schoolwork.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;We won't ever have another▼chance to spend so much time▼studying.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;So we students have to seize the▼day. Study, study, study, while▼you still can!

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;But that's totally the wrong way▼of doing things.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Some kids just don't understand▼why they have to study.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;But sooner or later, we will▼need the stuff we learn in▼school.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;At least, that's what my mon▼always says!
$024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Do you ever just sit at your▼desk and not do any studying?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You first have to pick a job▼you'd like to do and then figure▼out how to get that job.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You can't waste time. You should▼be working hard for your future▼right now!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;If all you do is work, then you▼won't have time for the other▼things in life.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;My mother always says she'd▼rather I study than help out▼around the house.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;The more interested you are in▼your studies, the better you'll▼do.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;No matter what the subject, try▼to find something in it that▼interests you.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;If you want to go on a diet, the▼best thing to do is fall in▼love.

$024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Vì tình yêu khiến▼con gái mạnh mẽ hơn.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When you start to really like▼someone, you get interested in▼the same things they are.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When you're in love with▼someone, you even end up loving▼the bad things about them.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;But you shouldn't let yourself▼become too blinded by love.

vi: Nhưng cũng đừng▼cố quá thành lố nhé.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Because that can turn someone▼off just as fast!
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Không thì đối phương▼tụt hứng ngay đấy!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;When you break up with someone,▼or when someone turns you down▼for a date, what do you do?
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Khi chia tay hoặc▼bị ai đó từ chối hẹn hò,▼cậu thường làm gì?

en: Become blue.$019'57;
vi: Buồn rầu.$019'57;

en: Stay cheerful.$019'58;
vi: Cứ vui vẻ.$019'58;

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I actually think it's best if▼you let yourself feel really,▼really bad for a while.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Tớ nghĩ cứ cho phép mình▼buồn thật buồn một thời gian▼lại là cách tốt nhất.

en: Then you can get over it faster,▼and bounce back better than▼ever!
vi: Rồi nỗi buồn sẽ qua nhanh,▼cậu lại mạnh mẽ hơn trước!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Ignoring your feelings won't▼make them go away, you know.
I think it's much better to just▼let yourself be sad for a while.
vi: Tớ nghĩ cứ cho mình▼buồn một chút vẫn tốt hơn.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It's a good idea to scout out▼locations for a date.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Hẹn hò thì nên▼đi khảo sát địa điểm trước.

en: Think about where you want to▼go, what you want to do.
vi: Nghĩ xem mình muốn đi đâu,▼làm những gì.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Try to find out what the other▼person likes to do as well.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Cũng nên tìm hiểu xem▼người kia thích làm gì.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;A really good date takes a lot▼of planning!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Một buổi hẹn tuyệt vời▼cần lên kế hoạch kỹ lắm!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;January 7th is the Festival of▼Seven Herbs.
Eat rice porridge with these▼seven herbs and you'll be▼healthy all year long.
vi: Ăn cháo nấu với bảy loại rau▼sẽ khỏe mạnh cả năm đấy.

en: They are dropwort, shepherd's▼purse, cudweed...
vi: Có cần nước,▼rau tề và rau khúc...

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;chickweed, basil, thyme,▼and of course mint.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;rau sao, húng quế,▼húng tây và tất nhiên là bạc hà.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I often help my teachers out▼with various things.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Tớ thường giúp thầy cô▼rất nhiều việc lặt vặt.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;So guess who they always ask▼first when they need help?
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Thế đoán xem mỗi khi cần giúp,▼thầy cô gọi ai đầu tiên?

en: I don't mind, of course. But▼sometimes I wish they'd call on▼someone else, you know?
vi: Tớ chẳng phiền đâu. Nhưng đôi▼lúc cũng muốn thầy cô▼gọi ai khác một lần!

en: It's easy enough to give someone▼a gift of chocolate.
vi: Tặng sô-cô-la cho ai đó▼thì dễ thôi.

en: But if you're on the receiving▼end, you have to give gifts in▼exchange.
vi: Nhưng người được tặng▼lại phải chuẩn bị quà đáp lễ.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;The worst thing is trying to▼remember who gave you what!
vi: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Khổ nhất là nhớ xem▼ai đã tặng mình món gì!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Every spring at Easter, my▼grandmother and I would paint▼Easter eggs.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Mỗi mùa Phục Sinh,▼tớ cùng bà tô màu trứng.

en: Later, she would hide them all▼around the house, and for every▼one we found...
vi: Rồi bà giấu chúng khắp nhà.▼Cứ tìm được một quả...

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;she would give me a chocolate▼egg in exchange. Yum-yum!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;là bà đổi cho tớ▼một quả trứng sô-cô-la. Ngon ơi là▼ngon!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Whenever I see an egg, I always▼think of spring.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Cứ thấy quả trứng,▼tớ lại nghĩ đến mùa xuân.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Oh, dear. When spring comes, my▼nose gets SO itchy!
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Ôi trời, cứ xuân về▼là mũi tớ ngứa kinh khủng!

en: And recently, it's not just▼springtime, either.
vi: Mà dạo gần đây,▼đâu chỉ mỗi mùa xuân nữa.

en: I get the same thing in other▼seasons, too.
vi: Các mùa khác▼tớ cũng bị như vậy.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;My eyes get so itchy, it makes▼it very hard to concentrate on▼my studies.
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Mắt ngứa đến mức▼chẳng tập trung học nổi!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;In late spring, the flower▼blossoms start to fall.
It always makes me a little sad▼to see those flowers falling to▼the ground.
vi: Nhìn hoa rụng xuống đất,▼tớ thấy hơi buồn.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;But at the same time, they're so▼pretty fluttering through the▼air.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Nhưng cùng lúc,▼cánh hoa bay trong gió▼cũng đẹp vô cùng.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Flowers are beautiful right to▼the very end.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Hoa đẹp đến tận▼khoảnh khắc cuối cùng.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Did you know that there are▼Seven Flowers of Fall, just like▼the Seven Herbs in January?
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Cậu biết mùa thu cũng có▼Bảy Loài Hoa, giống như▼Bảy Loại Rau tháng Một không?

en: I knew that!$019'71;
vi: Tớ biết rồi!$019'71;

en: Hmmm. That's news to me!$019'72;
vi: Ồ, giờ tớ mới biết!$019'72;

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Why don't you try writing a poem▼about them?
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Thử làm một bài thơ▼về những loài hoa ấy đi?

en: They're not for eating, you▼know. They're just meant to be▼looked at.
vi: Chúng không dùng để ăn đâu,▼chỉ để ngắm thôi nhé.
